result:
T-DG6-FE-F is implemented and left uncommitted, but two acceptance items are not met. The unit suites exit 1 on one failure that already exists on HEAD. The integration run was stopped after 30 minutes without completing, and it showed 3 failures I did not explain.

**What I delivered**
- **Explanation panels:** one panel component shows the formula in words, the period, the version, the inputs and the state. It opens from a labelled disclosure button and is read-only, so the auditor sees the same thing. It is mounted for:
  - the weighted score on the scorecard;
  - the benefit realized value on the benefit page;
  - NPV, ROI and payback on the financial-metrics page;
  - the health check score.

  It builds on KBE-B's view models and computes no business number. Unknown or incomplete values show a labelled icon chip, never 0 or green.
- **Status cues:** the Scorecard line-230 chip and the health-check and financial-metrics "unknown" chips now carry an icon. `Badges.test.tsx` proves the five statuses have distinct icons and labels in both languages. `status-tokens.test.ts` proves no status token is, or references, a blue token.
- **Catalogue completeness:** `problems-all.test.ts` scans 484 problem codes from the API source plus the P6 ADR tables. It found 14 codes with no text; I added en and ar text for each (Arabic labelled provisional), including BE-W's two contrast codes exactly as ADR-0061 §6.
- **Branding Settings:** a contrast refusal shows one form-level alert listing each failing colour pair, with token names and ratios kept left-to-right. A new contrast report shows any published version. A version published before the rule whose colours fail shows the warning text from the spec.
- **Strings made untrue:** none found. No migration, no new dependency, no API change, and no pending operations to route.

**Checks**

| Check | Exit | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Historical DG5 validator | 0 | PASS |
| `pnpm -r typecheck` | 0 | First parallel attempt was killed for memory (137); rerun one package at a time passed |
| `pnpm -r build` | 0 | Final web build also 0 |
| `pnpm lint` | 0 | |
| Prettier check | 0 | |
| `pnpm openapi:lint` | 0 | |
| `pnpm test`, locale unset | 1 | unit-node 2750/2750; unit-web 1936 passed, 1 failed; formula 259 passed, 2 skipped |
| `pnpm test`, C.UTF-8 | 1 | Same counts, same single failure |
| Integration | not complete | Stopped at the 30-minute background limit after 227 files; no pass claimed |

- **The unit failure** is `p6-admin-screens.test.tsx`, "identity … never a secret value". It finds FE-D's header search box. I reproduced it on a clean clone of HEAD 604996584 without my changes, so it is not caused by this task. The fix is probably to scope that assertion to `main`.
- **The integration run** showed 3 failures, all in files this task doesn't touch:
  - an assistant rate-limit test;
  - two contract response-validation tests, one of which timed out after 30 seconds.

  The run was competing with the other unit suite and a build. I have not established whether these failures already exist on HEAD. Please rerun integration in the foreground on the merged tree with nothing else running.

**Visual evidence:** Playwright screenshots in English and Arabic on the real stack are in `T-DG6-FE-F-evidence/screenshots/{en,ar}/`. They cover the weighted score (complete and incomplete), the benefit realized value, the health check (incomplete and scored), and the Branding refusal and recorded report. All 10 capture steps passed, with no serious or critical accessibility violations. The NPV/ROI/payback panel was not captured on the real stack; it is covered by component tests only.

**Decisions for you**
- **ADR-0061 §8 is wrong about benefit data:** the benefit detail call has no `realized.kpiActual`; only the register row does. For non-financial benefits only, the page reads it from the register query. Either correct the ADR or add the field later.
- **NPV/ROI/payback and health-check wording:** KBE-B found the ADR words don't cover some code behaviour, and no decision is recorded. I kept the ADR text verbatim and added one clearly separate notes sentence for each. If you'd rather amend the ADR, those keys can be folded in.
- **API typo:** `db-errors.ts` emits the field code `validation.validation.reference`. I gave it a text so users see a correct message; the owner should fix the code to `validation.reference`.
- **Shared files to merge by union:** `i18n/index.ts`, `{en,ar}/problems.json` and `provisional-ar-p6.ts`.

**Still open**
- Status chips outside my files still lack icons (seen in prioritization Rankings, RankedTable, WeightSets and p3ui, and three places in BenefitPage). QA-D's check will flag them.
- The full integration run and the NPV/ROI/payback real-stack screenshot.
- Each requirement (REQ-S15-003, -007, -012, -014) stays incomplete until FE-F2 and QA-D land.

I finished at 20:43Z, about 2 h 06 min, slightly over the limit.

Everything is in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG6/`:
- T-DG6-FE-F-frontend-ux-engineer.md
- T-DG6-FE-F-evidence/
